name: tastemaker
title_zh: 看一眼参考图就生成同气质界面的设计手
tagline_zh: 你贴一张Dribbble/Pinterest图，它提取配色、字体、圆角、间距，直接产出同风格界面。
tagline_en: Paste a Dribbble/Pinterest shot, it extracts colors, fonts, radii, spacing, and builds UI that matches. No more.
desc_en: Generate genuinely beautiful, on-brand UI instead of generic "AI slop" — use whenever the user asks to build, design, style, or improve a UI, landing page, dashboard, app screen, or component, whenever a PRD/spec needs a design pass before implementation, whenever the user pastes reference images/Pinterest/Dribbble links and wants the app to look like them, or whenever the user complains the AI-ge
why_zh: 它先解析参考图的视觉语言，再套用你的组件库，而不是凭空生成。风格迁移有结构，不是滤镜糊上去。
why_en: It parses the visual language of your reference, then applies it to your component library—structured style transfer, not a.
limit_zh: 只认静态参考图，不认Figma文件或设计token；产物是前端代码，不负责导出设计稿；若参考图是插画/3D渲染。
limit_en: Only static images, not Figma files or design tokens; outputs frontend code, not design specs; for illustrations/3D renders, it only extracts.
title_en: A UI stylist that matches the vibe of your reference image
